body:
SHITHUB epic kickoff. Real capability re-check (LO now has real Let/LetRef/Switch/Lambda/Call/StringLit/Match, but still one-defn-per-file, so the framework targets PARENA stdlib directly rather than waiting on qi). Answered the single-point-emoji question directly: no new LO grammar tokens needed this pass, everything is ordinary PARENA defstruct/defn. Defined the real 4-pillar Rails-like API: Routing (shipped, PARENA's routes.prn), Models/Controllers/Migrations (API defined, not yet built, IDUNA endpoint shape left open). Phase A/B marked done, new Phase B2/B3 named.

⚓ ☃
title: FRAMEWORK_NORTHSTAR.md -- real capability re-check + Rails-like API definition
